source_inspection.sideband_convention: set_mode retains positive FFT bins for USB and negative bins for LSB; forward FFT uses negative-exponent twiddles. For physical I=A*cos(wt), Q=A*sin(wt), Q lags I by quarter-cycle: positive complex frequency, USB stronger. Physical Q leading I by quarter-cycle gives negative complex frequency, LSB stronger. Displayed phase numbers alone do not establish physical orientation; scope lead/lag is required.
